instruction.name: xvpickve2gr.du
instruction.description: Pick the 64-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, zero-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

latencies.notes: vj -> rd. Chain: xvreplgr2vr.d then xvpickve2gr.du; the 1-cycle latency of the replication helper is subtracted (calibrated with vpickve2gr.b/h and xvpickve2gr.d/w). Three independent runs, spread 6.98-7.00 raw cycles.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvpickve2gr.du $r12, $xr8, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r13, $xr9, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r14, $xr10, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r15, $xr11, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r16, $xr12, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r17, $xr13, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r18, $xr14, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r19, $xr15, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvpickve2gr.du $r12, $xr8, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r13, $xr9, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r14, $xr10, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r15, $xr11, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r16, $xr12, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r17, $xr13, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r18, $xr14, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r19, $xr15, 0'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
